news.title: Hind Aluminium Industries Limited (BSE:531979) agreed to acquire Aluminium business of Nirav Commercials Limited from Nirav Commercials Limited (BSE:512425) for INR 12.5 million.
news.body:
Hind Aluminium Industries Limited (BSE:531979) agreed to acquire Aluminium business of Nirav Commercials Limited from Nirav Commercials Limited (BSE:512425) for INR 12.5 million on February 4, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 12.5 million will be paid by Hind Aluminium Industries Limited. As part of consideration, INR 12.5 million is paid towards assets of Aluminium business of Nirav Commercials Limited.

For the period ended March 31, 2025, Aluminium business of Nirav Commercials Limited reported a total revenue of INR 97.26 million.
